tools.name: calculate_rtc_official
tools.description: Computes Brazilian consumption-tax reform figures for one amount or a batch of up to 50 lines: it resolves the official Receita Federal cClassTrib classification from a code, NBS, NCM, LC 116 code or sector alias, applies the legal CBS/IBS reduction, the transition rates of the chosen year from 2026

tools.name: generate_danfse_rtc
tools.description: Produces the printable DANFSe of the Brazilian national NFS-e as self-contained HTML, with the access key, document number and verification code, and embeds the same official CBS/IBS/ISS calculation the engine performs from the Receita Federal Base V0073 tables. It accepts either structured provider

tools.name: rtc_lookup_official_tables
tools.description: Returns the reference data behind the calculator at no charge: the table-set metadata, the full 2026 to 2033 transition schedule with nominal CBS and IBS rates per year, the headline sector reductions with their cClassTrib code and the LC 214/2025 article that grants them, every accepted sector alia

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "calculate_rtc_official" stacks urgency/override words (always, never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_danfse_rtc · Private data: calculate_rtc_official, generate_danfse_rtc, rtc_lookup_official_tables · Public sink: generate_danfse_rtc, rtc_lookup_official_tables.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_danfse_rtc · Private data: calculate_rtc_official, generate_danfse_rtc, rtc_lookup_official_tables · Public sink: generate_danfse_rtc, rtc_lookup_official_tables

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "generate_danfse_rtc" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Gera o DANFSe oficial da NFS-e Nacional e calcula automaticamente CBS/IBS/ISS usando as tabelas oficiais MIT da Receita Federal (Base V0073 — 170 cClassTrib, reduções legais de construção civil 50%, saúde 60%, educação 60%, cesta básica 100%, Simples Nacional e transição 2026–2033) no Cloudflare Edg" → after: "Produces the printable DANFSe of the Brazilian national NFS-e as self-contained HTML, with the access key, document number and verification code, and embeds the same official CBS/IBS/ISS calculation the engine performs from the Receita Federal Base V0073 tables. It accepts either structured provider"

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
